notes.title: DyingNoise Update Data Ver. 2.0.1 (2025.01.31)
notes.content: Fixed an issue where achievements added in Day:X were not unlocking.

notes.title: "Day:X" Release (2025/01/31 DyingNoise Ver.2.0.0) : Japanese Only
notes.content:
It's Time to Enjoy the Listening Experience Once Again!
We are excited to introduce DyingNoise Day:X, a brand-new evolution of DyingNoise!

Below are the details of the update. (Please note that this update is available in Japanese only.)

[Added "Memory" to the Menu]
We have added a new feature called "Memory" to the menu.
This Memory feature includes two collectible elements:

When you read "Notes" found along the journey, their contents will be reflected.
Displays the phrases from the voices you distinguished at the torii gates, along with the number of times you have cleared them.
[Over 20 New Voice Samples Added]
Thanks to the support of many streamers, we have had the opportunity to watch numerous playthroughs. While reviewing these streams, the development team was surprised to see that the voices were relatively easy to distinguish, leading to quicker clears than expected.
In response, this update includes a selection of much more challenging voice samples—even ones that are difficult for the developers themselves to differentiate! Additionally, we have adjusted the game so that these new samples appear earlier in the experience.

[Other Fixes]
Various bug fixes and adjustments have been made, including:

Fixed an issue where conversations would not progress after talking to the character at the starting point.
Fixed a bug where players would become unable to move after passing through the first torii gate.

notes.title: [Dying Noise] Latest update: Ver. 1.1.0 (Released August 16, 2024)
notes.content:
:We’ve added an auto-dash feature. If you turn it ON in the settings, you'll be able to dash without pressing the Shift key.

:We’ve improved the volume adjustment feature.
*Please note that Japanese language support is not yet implemented. This will be fixed in a future update.

:Adjustments have been made so that more challenging voice cues appear more frequently in the later stages.

notes.title: [Dying Noise] Latest update: Ver. 1.0.1 (Released August 16, 2024)
notes.content: We have fixed the issue where the volume would be set to 0 when launching the game.
